import requests, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

B62="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V  B  Z  X  *

L=B62.strip().split("\n"); AA=L[0].split(); idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
MAT=np.array([[int(x) for x in l.split()[1:]] for l in L[1:]],dtype=np.int32)
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,idx['X']) for c in s],dtype=np.int32)
def sw(s1,s2,go=11,ge=1):
    a,b=enc(s1),enc(s2); n,m=len(a),len(b); sub=MAT[a][:,b]
    H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int32); E=np.full((n+1,m+1),-10**6,np.int32); ptr=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        E[i]=np.maximum(E[i-1]-ge,H[i-1]-go)
        Hr=H[i]; pr=ptr[i]; dg=H[i-1][:-1]+sub[i-1]; Ei=E[i]; fp=-10**6; hp=0
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            fp=max(fp-ge,hp-go); best=0; p=0; d=dg[j-1]
            if d>best: best=d; p=1
            if Ei[j]>best: best=Ei[j]; p=2
            if fp>best: best=fp; p=3
            Hr[j]=best; pr[j]=p; hp=best
    i,j=np.unravel_index(np.argmax(H),H.shape); sc=int(H[i,j]); ide=0; al=0
    while i>0 and j>0 and ptr[i,j]!=0:
        p=ptr[i,j]
        if p==1:
            al+=1
            if s1[i-1]==s2[j-1]: ide+=1
            i-=1;j-=1
        elif p==2: al+=1;i-=1
        else: al+=1;j-=1
    return sc,(100*ide/al if al else 0),al
def fam(q,size=200):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":q,"fields":"accession,gene_names,protein_name,sequence","size":size,"format":"json"},timeout=180)
    o=[]
    for e in r.json().get("results",[]):
        g=None
        if e.get("genes"):
            g=e["genes"][0].get("geneName",{}).get("value") or (e["genes"][0].get("orfNames") or [{}])[0].get("value")
        o.append(dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],gene=g,seq=e["sequence"]["value"]))
    return o
def fetch(a): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")

human=[h for h in fam('organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true AND (family:"DEAD box helicase family" OR gene:DDX*)')
       if h["gene"] and h["gene"].upper().startswith(("DDX","EIF4A","DHX"))]
fly=[h for h in fam('organism_id:7227 AND reviewed:true AND (family:"DEAD box helicase family" OR family:"DEAH box helicase family")')]
print("human n=",len(human),"fly n=",len(fly))
pths=fetch("Q9VIF6"); ddx47=fetch("Q9H0S4")

fwd=pd.DataFrame([dict(target=h["gene"],acc=h["acc"],**dict(zip(["sw","pid","aln"],sw(pths,h["seq"])))) for h in human]).sort_values("sw",ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
rev=pd.DataFrame([dict(target=f["gene"],acc=f["acc"],**dict(zip(["sw","pid","aln"],sw(ddx47,f["seq"])))) for f in fly]).sort_values("sw",ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
fwd["pid"]=fwd["pid"].round(1); rev["pid"]=rev["pid"].round(1)
print("\nFORWARD fly Porthos(Q9VIF6) -> human DEAD/DEAH-box\n", fwd.head(10).to_string(index=False))
print("\nREVERSE human DDX47(Q9H0S4) -> fly DEAD/DEAH-box\n", rev.head(10).to_string(index=False))
print("\nRBH satisfied:", fwd.iloc[0]["target"]=="DDX47" and rev.iloc[0]["acc"]=="Q9VIF6",
      "| forward margin (SW) %dx, reverse margin %.2fx"%(fwd.iloc[0]['sw']/fwd.iloc[1]['sw'], rev.iloc[0]['sw']/rev.iloc[1]['sw']))
fwd.to_csv("/tmp/rbh_forward.csv",index=False); rev.to_csv("/tmp/rbh_reverse.csv",index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.5))
for ax,df,title,hl in [(axes[0],fwd.head(12),"Fly Porthos (pths, Q9VIF6)\nvs human DEAD/DEAH-box family","DDX47"),
                       (axes[1],rev.head(12),"Human DDX47 (Q9H0S4)\nvs fly DEAD/DEAH-box family","pths")]:
    cols=["#c0392b" if t==hl else "#7f8c8d" for t in df["target"]]
    ax.barh(range(len(df))[::-1], df["sw"], color=cols)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(df))[::-1]); ax.set_yticklabels(df["target"],fontsize=9)
    for y,(s,p) in zip(range(len(df))[::-1], zip(df["sw"],df["pid"])):
        ax.text(s+20,y,f"{p:.0f}% id",va="center",fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlabel("Smith-Waterman score (BLOSUM62, gap 11/1)"); ax.set_title(title,fontsize=10)
    ax.set_xlim(0, df["sw"].max()*1.22); ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
fig.suptitle("Reciprocal best hit: Drosophila Porthos and human DDX47 are 1:1 orthologs",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
